source_scope: Full project inherited from exact public baseline; only three named GD files change runtime behavior/material. Tested raw source and sidecars are bound by SOURCE_PIN and exact import/native/fullCI guards. Manifest covers every changed payload path and the selected required source/rule/provenance/current-context dependencies. It does not claim a new whole-game visual inventory or fresh verification of every file in the separately published R85 historical archive.
post_payload_own_metadata: REMOTE_VERIFICATION and later receipt/gate/impact metadata are separately checked at their final immutable revision. Manifest itself is verified by exact length/hash in the receipt.
acceptance: Work-branch review only; no dev integration, accepted removal, whole-game denominator, formalQA11/device/child/owner or release acceptance.
